text:
maya: encountering a weird edgecase in the JS onboarding sample: if you hit abort + reconnect within ~60ms the client gets [DONE] then a stray data line and JSON.parse throws. repro on Chrome + local dev proxy. anyone seen this?

chris: hmm, paste the capture if you have it.

maya: sure, raw stream snippet:
data: {"i":1,"t":"a"}
data: {"i":2,"t":"b"}
data: [DONE]
data: {"i":2,"t":"!"}

chris: that looks like the proxy replayed a buffered packet after server closed the response. we changed the proxy flush behavior recently.

dan: client-side guard is low risk: ignore any data events after [DONE] for that connection. keep parity by adding the same behavior to other SDKs.

maya: implemented that in my local branch and it prevents the crash.

chris: infra should still audit the proxy/tcp flags; long-term we want strict ordering. will open infra ticket.

ci-bot: Issue opened: #4991 - "onboarding sample: post-DONE stray SSE fragment on fast reconnects" (reported by chris)

dan: next steps: 1) roll short client guard across SDKs + changelogs, 2) add e2e test in sampleapp to simulate proxy flush, 3) infra investigates proxy flush ordering.

maya: also adding a one-line note to the sampleapp README so new users won't be confused.

chris: thanks all — small mitigation + infra follow-up sounds good.
